headline: Rupiah Menguat ke Rp18.200/US$ Setelah BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%
summary: The rupiah strengthened against the US dollar after Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6% on Wednesday, 18 November 2026.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's benchmark interest rate, and its decisions shape the rupiah, bond yields and capital flows.
why_moved: The rupiah strengthened immediately after Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate to 6%.
